---
title: "Module 05: Single-cell RNA-seq cell-cell communication analysis with CellChat"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-06"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 05 — Single-cell CellChat communication analysis
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Infer global cell-cell communication networks from the SingleR-annotated
#   single-cell RNA-seq dataset using CellChat.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds
#
# Primary outputs:
#   data/processed/single_cell/cellchat/
#     GSE298688_CellChat_SingleR_broad.rds
#     GSE298688_CellChat_input_Seurat.rds
#
#   results/single_cell/cellchat/
#   figures/single_cell/cellchat/
#
# Notes:
#   - Broad SingleR annotations define CellChat groups.
#   - Unassigned cells are excluded.
#   - Cell types containing fewer than 10 cells are excluded.
#   - Large cell populations are downsampled to a maximum of 1,000 cells.
#   - Communication probabilities use a 10% truncated mean.
#   - Population size is not incorporated because cell populations are
#     intentionally downsampled.
#   - Top pathways are selected only for visualization. Complete CellChat
#     results are retained in the exported tables and CellChat object.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(CellChat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(future)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis parameters

annotation_column <- "SingleR_broad_pruned"

minimum_cells_per_group <- 10
maximum_cells_per_group <- 1000

communication_mean_type <- "truncatedMean"
communication_trim <- 0.1

top_n_pathways <- 20

cellchat_workers <- 4


# Repository paths

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)

cellchat_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell",
  "cellchat"
)

cellchat_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "cellchat"
)

cellchat_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "cellchat"
)


for (directory in c(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  cellchat_results_directory,
  cellchat_figure_directory
)) {

  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds"
)

cellchat_output_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_SingleR_broad.rds"
)

cellchat_input_seurat_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  "GSE298688_CellChat_input_Seurat.rds"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare CellChat input
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 04 output not found: ",
    input_file
  )
}


message("Loading SingleR-annotated single-cell object...")

single_cell <- readRDS(
  input_file
)

DefaultAssay(single_cell) <- "RNA"


if (!annotation_column %in% colnames(single_cell@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "Required SingleR annotation column not found: ",
    annotation_column
  )
}


# Join Seurat v5 RNA layers before CellChat analysis.

if (
  length(
    Layers(
      single_cell[["RNA"]]
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  message("Joining RNA assay layers...")

  single_cell <- JoinLayers(
    single_cell,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}


# Remove cells without confident broad SingleR annotations.

valid_cells <- colnames(single_cell)[
  !is.na(single_cell[[annotation_column]][, 1]) &
    single_cell[[annotation_column]][, 1] != "Unassigned"
]


single_cell_cellchat <- subset(
  single_cell,
  cells = valid_cells
)


single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type <- factor(
  single_cell_cellchat[[annotation_column]][, 1]
)


# Remove very small cell populations.

cell_type_counts <- table(
  single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type
)


cell_types_to_keep <- names(
  cell_type_counts[
    cell_type_counts >= minimum_cells_per_group
  ]
)


single_cell_cellchat <- subset(
  single_cell_cellchat,
  subset = cellchat_cell_type %in% cell_types_to_keep
)


single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type <- droplevels(
  single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Downsample large cell populations
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Large cell populations are capped to prevent abundant populations such as
# microglia from dominating computation and to keep group sizes more balanced.

set.seed(1234)


cells_by_type <- split(
  colnames(single_cell_cellchat),
  single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type
)


cells_to_keep <- unlist(
  lapply(
    cells_by_type,
    function(cells) {

      if (length(cells) > maximum_cells_per_group) {

        sample(
          cells,
          maximum_cells_per_group
        )

      } else {

        cells
      }
    }
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)


single_cell_cellchat <- subset(
  single_cell_cellchat,
  cells = cells_to_keep
)


single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type <- droplevels(
  single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type
)

Idents(single_cell_cellchat) <- "cellchat_cell_type"


final_cell_type_counts <- sort(
  table(
    single_cell_cellchat$cellchat_cell_type
  ),
  decreasing = TRUE
)


print(final_cell_type_counts)


cell_type_count_table <- data.frame(
  cell_type = names(final_cell_type_counts),
  cells = as.integer(final_cell_type_counts)
)


write.csv(
  cell_type_count_table,
  file.path(
    cellchat_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_cell_type_counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


message(
  "CellChat input: ",
  ncol(single_cell_cellchat),
  " cells across ",
  length(final_cell_type_counts),
  " cell types."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Run CellChat
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Creating CellChat object...")

cellchat <- CellChat::createCellChat(
  object = single_cell_cellchat,
  group.by = "cellchat_cell_type",
  assay = "RNA"
)


# Use the complete mouse CellChat database.

cellchat@DB <- CellChat::CellChatDB.mouse


# Retain signaling genes represented in the CellChat database.

cellchat <- CellChat::subsetData(
  cellchat
)


future::plan(
  strategy = "multisession",
  workers = cellchat_workers
)


message(
  "Identifying overexpressed signaling genes and interactions..."
)

cellchat <- CellChat::identifyOverExpressedGenes(
  cellchat
)

cellchat <- CellChat::identifyOverExpressedInteractions(
  cellchat
)


message(
  "Computing cell-cell communication probabilities..."
)

cellchat <- CellChat::computeCommunProb(
  object = cellchat,
  type = communication_mean_type,
  trim = communication_trim,
  raw.use = TRUE,
  population.size = FALSE,
  distance.use = FALSE,
  seed.use = 1234
)


cellchat <- CellChat::filterCommunication(
  cellchat,
  min.cells = minimum_cells_per_group
)


# Aggregate ligand-receptor interactions into signaling pathways.

cellchat <- CellChat::computeCommunProbPathway(
  cellchat
)

cellchat <- CellChat::aggregateNet(
  cellchat
)


# Calculate incoming and outgoing signaling centrality.

cellchat <- CellChat::netAnalysis_computeCentrality(
  cellchat,
  slot.name = "netP"
)


future::plan(
  strategy = "sequential"
)


message(
  "CellChat inference complete: ",
  length(cellchat@netP$pathways),
  " signaling pathways detected."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Export communication results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Ligand-receptor-level interactions.

communication_table <- CellChat::subsetCommunication(
  cellchat
)


write.csv(
  communication_table,
  file.path(
    cellchat_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_ligand_receptor_interactions.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Pathway-level interactions.

pathway_communication_table <- CellChat::subsetCommunication(
  cellchat,
  slot.name = "netP"
)


write.csv(
  pathway_communication_table,
  file.path(
    cellchat_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_pathway_interactions.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Rank global signaling pathways
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Sum pathway-level communication probabilities across all source-target
# combinations to rank global pathway information flow.

pathway_strength <- apply(
  cellchat@netP$prob,
  3,
  sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


pathway_strength_table <- data.frame(
  pathway = names(pathway_strength),
  information_flow = as.numeric(pathway_strength)
) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(information_flow)
  )


write.csv(
  pathway_strength_table,
  file.path(
    cellchat_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_pathway_information_flow.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


top_pathways <- pathway_strength_table %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = top_n_pathways
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    pathway
  )


message(
  "Top pathways selected for visualization: ",
  paste(
    top_pathways,
    collapse = ", "
  )
)

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Global communication heatmaps
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Heatmaps provide a complementary view of the aggregated network.
# Rows represent sending populations and columns represent receiving
# populations.

interaction_count_heatmap <- CellChat::netVisual_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  measure = "count",
  color.heatmap = "Blues"
)

interaction_strength_heatmap <- CellChat::netVisual_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  measure = "weight",
  color.heatmap = "Blues"
)


# Save interaction-number heatmap.

png(
  filename = file.path(
    cellchat_figure_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_interaction_count_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  interaction_count_heatmap
)

dev.off()


# Save interaction-strength heatmap.

png(
  filename = file.path(
    cellchat_figure_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_interaction_strength_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  interaction_strength_heatmap
)

dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Global CellChat networks
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

group_size <- as.numeric(
  table(
    cellchat@idents
  )
)


# Number of inferred interactions

png(
  filename = file.path(
    cellchat_figure_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_interaction_count_network.png"
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

CellChat::netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$count,
  vertex.weight = group_size,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Number of interactions"
)

dev.off()


# Overall inferred interaction strength

png(
  filename = file.path(
    cellchat_figure_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_interaction_strength_network.png"
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)

CellChat::netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = group_size,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Interaction strength"
)

dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Global pathway summaries
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Show only the strongest pathways in publication-facing figures.
# The complete pathway analysis remains available in the CellChat object
# and exported tables.


# Top pathway information flow

top_pathway_table <- pathway_strength_table %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = top_n_pathways
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway = factor(
      pathway,
      levels = rev(pathway)
    )
  )


information_flow_plot <- ggplot(
  top_pathway_table,
  aes(
    x = pathway,
    y = information_flow
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top Signaling Pathways",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Information flow"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


print(
  information_flow_plot
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    cellchat_figure_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_top_pathway_information_flow.png"
  ),
  plot = information_flow_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 400
)


# Incoming signaling patterns

png(
  filename = file.path(
    cellchat_figure_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_top_pathways_incoming_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)


CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  pattern = "incoming",
  signaling = top_pathways,
  title = "Incoming signaling patterns"
)


dev.off()


# Outgoing signaling patterns

png(
  filename = file.path(
    cellchat_figure_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_top_pathways_outgoing_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 400
)


CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  pattern = "outgoing",
  signaling = top_pathways,
  title = "Outgoing signaling patterns"
)


dev.off()


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Global signaling roles
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Summarize each cell population by its overall incoming and outgoing
# communication strength.

signaling_role_scatter <- CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(
  cellchat
)


print(
  signaling_role_scatter
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    cellchat_figure_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_signaling_role_scatter.png"
  ),
  plot = signaling_role_scatter,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 400
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Representative pathway-level signaling networks
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Visualize representative signaling pathways identified from the global
# CellChat analysis.
#
# ApoE and SELPLG were selected for detailed visualization based on their
# distinct outgoing signaling patterns in the global pathway heatmap.
#
# These plots illustrate:
#   1. The inferred source-to-target communication structure for each pathway.
#   2. The relative contribution of individual ligand-receptor interactions
#      to the pathway-level communication network.


# Define representative pathways.

representative_pathways <- c(
  "ApoE",
  "SELPLG"
)


# Check which pathways were detected by CellChat.

available_pathways <- cellchat@netP$pathways

missing_representative_pathways <- setdiff(
  representative_pathways,
  available_pathways
)


if (length(missing_representative_pathways) > 0) {

  warning(
    "The following representative pathways were not detected by CellChat: ",
    paste(
      missing_representative_pathways,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


representative_pathways_to_plot <- intersect(
  representative_pathways,
  available_pathways
)


message(
  "Representative pathways available for visualization: ",
  paste(
    representative_pathways_to_plot,
    collapse = ", "
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.1 ApoE signaling network
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if ("ApoE" %in% representative_pathways_to_plot) {

  png(
    filename = file.path(
      cellchat_figure_directory,
      "GSE298688_CellChat_ApoE_signaling_network.png"
    ),
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    units = "in",
    res = 400
  )


  CellChat::netVisual_aggregate(
    cellchat,
    signaling = "ApoE",
    layout = "circle"
  )


  dev.off()


  message(
    "Saved ApoE signaling network."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.2 ApoE ligand-receptor contribution
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if ("ApoE" %in% representative_pathways_to_plot) {

  apoe_contribution_plot <- CellChat::netAnalysis_contribution(
    cellchat,
    signaling = "ApoE"
  )


  print(
    apoe_contribution_plot
  )


  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      cellchat_figure_directory,
      "GSE298688_CellChat_ApoE_ligand_receptor_contribution.png"
    ),
    plot = apoe_contribution_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 400
  )


  message(
    "Saved ApoE ligand-receptor contribution plot."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.3 SELPLG signaling network
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if ("SELPLG" %in% representative_pathways_to_plot) {

  png(
    filename = file.path(
      cellchat_figure_directory,
      "GSE298688_CellChat_SELPLG_signaling_network.png"
    ),
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    units = "in",
    res = 400
  )


  CellChat::netVisual_aggregate(
    cellchat,
    signaling = "SELPLG",
    layout = "circle"
  )


  dev.off()


  message(
    "Saved SELPLG signaling network."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.4 SELPLG ligand-receptor contribution
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if ("SELPLG" %in% representative_pathways_to_plot) {

  selplg_contribution_plot <- CellChat::netAnalysis_contribution(
    cellchat,
    signaling = "SELPLG"
  )


  print(
    selplg_contribution_plot
  )


  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      cellchat_figure_directory,
      "GSE298688_CellChat_SELPLG_ligand_receptor_contribution.png"
    ),
    plot = selplg_contribution_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 400
  )


  message(
    "Saved SELPLG ligand-receptor contribution plot."
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Representative pathway-level chord diagrams
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Chord diagrams provide a compact visualization of pathway-specific
# communication between sending and receiving cell populations.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ApoE signaling chord diagram
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if ("ApoE" %in% cellchat@netP$pathways) {

  png(
    filename = file.path(
      cellchat_figure_directory,
      "GSE298688_CellChat_ApoE_signaling_chord.png"
    ),
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    units = "in",
    res = 400
  )

  CellChat::netVisual_aggregate(
    cellchat,
    signaling = "ApoE",
    layout = "chord"
  )

  dev.off()

  message(
    "Saved ApoE signaling chord diagram."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SELPLG signaling chord diagram
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if ("SELPLG" %in% cellchat@netP$pathways) {

  png(
    filename = file.path(
      cellchat_figure_directory,
      "GSE298688_CellChat_SELPLG_signaling_chord.png"
    ),
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    units = "in",
    res = 400
  )

  CellChat::netVisual_aggregate(
    cellchat,
    signaling = "SELPLG",
    layout = "chord"
  )

  dev.off()

  message(
    "Saved SELPLG signaling chord diagram."
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Save parameters and analysis objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat_parameters <- data.frame(

  parameter = c(
    "annotation_column",
    "minimum_cells_per_group",
    "maximum_cells_per_group",
    "cellchat_database",
    "communication_mean_type",
    "communication_trim",
    "raw_use",
    "population_size",
    "distance_use",
    "top_pathways_visualized",
    "representative_pathways",
    "parallel_workers"
  ),

  value = c(
    annotation_column,
    minimum_cells_per_group,
    maximum_cells_per_group,
    "CellChatDB.mouse",
    communication_mean_type,
    communication_trim,
    TRUE,
    FALSE,
    FALSE,
    top_n_pathways,
    paste(
      representative_pathways,
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    cellchat_workers
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  cellchat_parameters,
  file.path(
    cellchat_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_CellChat_parameters.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


saveRDS(
  cellchat,
  cellchat_output_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


saveRDS(
  single_cell_cellchat,
  cellchat_input_seurat_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


message(
  "Module 05 complete: ",
  ncol(single_cell_cellchat),
  " cells; ",
  length(final_cell_type_counts),
  " cell types; ",
  nrow(communication_table),
  " ligand-receptor interactions; ",
  length(cellchat@netP$pathways),
  " signaling pathways."
)
```
